[[Mehtani Keys]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Kodlonu Hamlet world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Kodlonu Hamlet inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside | pic3 = [[Image:Kodlonu Hamlet henchmen campfire.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = The henchmen by the campfire }} [[Kodlonu Hamlet]] is the central marketplace for the fishing settlements of southeastern Istan. It is also apparently a noted location for fenced goods. {{Quotation|game| The annual storms that wash over the [[Mehtani Keys]] force residents of Kodlonu Hamlet to rebuild on a regular basis. Thus, this central marketplace for the keys and the [[Issnur Isles]] is dominated by tent-and-pole construction. Most merchants merely fish their old, stained tents from the surf and begin anew each season, selling wares only found in the keys, specialty items from afar that have somehow bypassed [[Kamadan|Kamadan's]] customs, and lost cargo "rescued" from the corsairs. }} ==Getting there== Kodlonu Hamlet is located southeast of [[Beknur Harbor]], across the [[Issnur Isles]].
